comment: K1059 was decisive: the terminal-normalized plain networks D and C outranked all three unnormalized-tail networks. K1006 supported D’s additional normalization, though it does not establish a deterministic D-over-C rule. Among the remaining choices, shallow rectifier A avoided E’s deep smooth unnormalized tail, while B additionally lacked normalization throughout. K1038 cautioned against treating zero-LN smooth networks as universally frozen; B’s last-place ranking is recipe-specific. This result supports the existing terminal-normalization preference under shared momentum SGD, without establishing a new activation or depth rule.
